resources.string: Ukuze uqedele okokufundisa, swayiphela phezulu ngeminwe emi-3, futhi uthole inketho yokufundisa yokuqeda
Imenyu yezinketho ivuliwe. Manje ungasebenzisa ukuthinta okujwayelekile SandFly ukuze uzulazule. Swayiphela kwesokudla ukuze ubone ezinye izinketho.

Ngekhibhodi ye-braille, ungathepha isikrini sakho ukuze ufake i-braille yamachashazi angu-6.\n\nUsebenzisa i-Braille YesiNgisi Ehlanganisiwe. Ukuze ushintshe ulimi lwakho lokufaka, hamba kuzilungiselelo SandFly.
Umunwe wakho wenkomba ongakwesobunxele kufanele ube kuchashazi 1. Manje, cindezela ichashazi 1 ukuze uthayiphe uhlamvu “A”.
